name: AI Usage
description: Three tools in one. Usage: a private dashboard for your Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity and OpenCode spend — token counts and cost estimates by day and model, read entirely from your local session logs, and never sent anywhere. Leaderboard: every major model ranked on reasoning, coding and agent ratings, with context windows, prices and licences side by side. Open Source: work out which downloadable models your own hardware can actually run.
